pages.text: The room was full of books. Books filled the shelves right up to the ceiling.
Dad held up one finger. "Just one book today."
Pongi ran a finger along the books. Dad had already pulled one out. "This one is fun. It has boats in it."
Dad pulled out another. "This one is fun too. It has boats in it too."
Five books were piled in Dad's arms. Every one was about boats.
Pongi was looking at the bottom shelf. One book had big pictures.
Pongi pulled that book out. "I want this one."
Dad put all five books back. He looked disappointed.
That night, Pongi came out for a drink of water.
Dad was sitting under the light. He was reading the book Pongi had borrowed.
